perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Centrus announced a definitive multi-year HALEU supply contract with Antares on 2026-09-17, with deliveries before decade-end and prepayments supporting expanded domestic enrichment capacity.
This is incremental demand evidence after the earlier Radiant contract and strengthens the signal that commercial/national-security HALEU backlog is broadening beyond a single customer.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Customer contracts and prepayments improve demand visibility but do not by themselves prove commercial-scale enrichment ramp execution.
The execution test remains timely capacity expansion, delivery qualification and economics under the DOE-backed scale-up.

unknowns: aggregate committed HALEU volume versus planned capacity

sources.use: new binding HALEU demand and prepayment evidence

lineage.searchStrategy: fresh issuer primary-source acquisition targeted to post-prior-run commercial demand evidence
